title: Python Initiated Connection
description: Detects a Python process initiating a network connection. While this often relates to package installation, it can also indicate a potential malicious script communicating with a C&C server.
author: frack113

logsource.definition: Requirements: Field enrichment is required for the filters to work. As field such as CommandLine and ParentImage are not available by default on this event type

detection.condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
